businessGoal: Improve user navigation through product listings

scenarios.goal: Verify that pagination controls are displayed when there are more products than fit on one page
Verify that clicking a page number updates the product grid to show products for that page
Verify that the current page number is visually highlighted after navigation

clarifications: No scenarios mentioned for behavior when there are no products or exactly one page of products.

manual.reason: The story describes visible browser behavior and user interactions with pagination controls.

api.reason: The pagination behavior is primarily UI-focused and does not involve data validation through an API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria involve UI elements like pagination controls and page updates that are visible to the user.
